name: Hallelujah General Hospital

timeline_as_published.event: Hallelujah Center for Internal Medicine and Chest Disease PLC was established.
The center became formally operational on Bole Road, in front of Bole Printing Press.
The organization changed its name to Hallelujah Higher Medical Clinic PLC.
The source says the clinic provided general and pulmonary medicine and later constructed a G+6 building, described as eight stories including basement and ground floors.
The source says the hospital became fully operational after an inauguration attended by then-President Mulatu Teshome and public officials.

story.overview_as_published: Hallelujah Hospital provides a comprehensive service at one place, from diagnosis to major surgeries.

mission_as_published: To be customer’s first choice, provide high quality and specialized medical care through specialized diagnostic, treatment services, and trusted care at competitive cost and best service enriched by research and training, thereby complementing the preventive medical services rendered by the Government of Ethiopia.
vision_as_published: Our hospital aspires to be a well-organized, technologically advanced, and the leading healthcare provider in the horn Africa. We are dedicated to provide quality medical services. We are very meticulous to the details of medical standards, hospitality and compassion to the satisfaction of our clients.
